assumptions.officialRules: 75 initial gold; tower 25; stone wall 1; sample ore sale prices 1/3/5; vouchers 100/150; upgrades restore full HP; damaged buildings can be replaced; no free daily healing
assumptions.markets: Initial six ore nodes and market coordinates come from upstream sample; scenario base locations are retained from the prior arena, not an official complete map
assumptions.waves: Original three heavy waves unchanged; extend deterministically to ten with wave_counts; schedules/spawns are hypotheses, not official waves
assumptions.robotTargeting: nearest attacks nearest own-camp target within 3; advance moves toward base despite reachable side targets and attacks through walls; both are unverified hypotheses
assumptions.settlement: Same documented damage/cooldown as prior arena; ray-cell ties, robot pathing and priority among simultaneous commands remain local conventions
assumptions.resourceConflicts: A valid observed collection can lose the final ore to another actor in the same round; report these failed actions separately without hiding them
assumptions.omitted: Official tasks, news, treasure, summons, direct player damage; income only from actually mined and sold ore
assumptions.runtime: Every action uses the actual packaged-policy source; levels, cash and HP carried across nights; dead characters revive after 20 daylight rounds
assumptions.limit: Synthetic comparisons do not establish official survival or win rate; holdout used only after choosing the candidate
